q2_gaps: path / traversal preposition on a motion verb ("walks through the ward"; also across / along / past): Location is licensed for "in/at/on", Source for "from", Goal for "to", and the preposition-named oblique is scoped to PPs naming what the activity is about or directed at, so no form is assigned to a route PP
notes: Location is defensible because the PP answers "where" under the stated where/when/how/whence/whither test, but it loses the traversal reading a preposition-named (Through ...) oblique would keep. Everything else is correct: indefinite subject as a witness, Agent for a self-propelled intransitive subject, definite "the ward" as a typed individual, and no status atom on a bare simple present.
